remarks: Nantucket style shingle colonial, constructed by a local team of respected architects and builders on one of Compo Beach's most popular cul-de-sac's. Just steps from the water, yet out of the flood zone, this home offers the added benefit of natural gas, city water and public sewer. No detail has been overlooked in this stylish home blending high end traditional and modern finishes on four finished levels. Perfect for todays lifestyle, living areas offer a combination of open and separate spaces. Special features include an in-law/guest suite with separate entrance, kitchen and bathroom; finished 3rd floor with full bathroom, 3 car garage with soaring ceilings, epoxy floors and high end built-ins, and 3 season, screened in porch accessible from the kitchen and the outdoor pool/patio. The fully finished and tricked out lower level offers a media room, art studio, rec/playroom with wet bar and fireplace, and additional flex spaces offering tons of optionality. Set on 0.66 dry acres, no expense has been spared in creating the perfect outdoor oasis with heated gunite pool/spa with electric/solar, extensive patio, outdoor kitchen, fireplace, outdoor shower and gorgeous privacy landscaping. This is the home you have been dreaming of. Priced to sell! No showings until Wednesday March 17th.
